# invariant factors　`def.invariant-factor`
English entry · root `../`
[in graph](../#n=def.invariant-factor)　·　[Chinese page (authoritative)](./def.invariant-factor.md)

**Relation to elementary divisors**: factor each $d_i$ into powers of irreducible polynomials; the resulting prime-power factors are the elementary divisors. When the field splits, the Jordan normal form is stated in terms of elementary divisors.

**Matrix version vs operator version**: the Smith normal form applies to arbitrary matrices (possibly rectangular, over a ring); the invariant factors of an operator are those of the special matrix $xI - A$.

> Proofs of the edges are still Chinese only: `proofs/`; the Chinese page remains authoritative.
